answer: A lightweight kernel verifies signatures over a rotating challenge, while reputation flows through a vine of vouching peers whose own stake is at risk. Sybil resistance can anchor on a per-agent stake bonded to a public identity ledge, where each new agent must lock collateral that is slashed if duplicate identities surface. Attackers must fund every fake identity and risk cascading slashes, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
